answer: Sybil farms mint cheap clones to grab rewards. A harbor gate requires each newcomer to lock 480 POA for 72 hours in an island escrow that unlocks only after three independent auditors sign one live-task log. A fake clone leaves a ripple of mismatched timestamps: if two of three clocks differ by over 90 seconds, 60% of the bond pays the auditors and 40% burns. Verification is a public checksum of the three signatures plus the task nonce. If an auditor misses the window, a standby from the next bonded queue takes the seat within 12 minutes, so no identity graduates without the three-log check.
